entries.title: II Chronicles 29:1
segments: ¶Hezekiah became king [when he was] twenty-five years old, and he reigned twenty-nine years in Jerusalem. His mother's name [was] Abijah the daughter of Zechariah.

entries.title: II Chronicles 29:2
segments: And he did [what was] right in the sight of the LORD, according to all that his father David had done.

entries.title: II Chronicles 29:3
segments: In the first year of his reign, in the first month, he opened the doors of the house of the LORD and repaired them.

entries.title: II Chronicles 29:4
segments: Then he brought in the priests and the Levites, and gathered them in the East Square,

entries.title: II Chronicles 29:5
segments: and said to them: "Hear me, Levites! Now sanctify yourselves, sanctify the house of the LORD God of your fathers, and carry out the rubbish from the holy [place].

entries.title: II Chronicles 29:6
segments: "For our fathers have trespassed and done evil in the eyes of the LORD our God; they have forsaken Him, have turned their faces away from the dwelling place of the LORD, and turned [their] backs [on Him].

entries.title: II Chronicles 29:7
segments: "They have also shut up the doors of the vestibule, put out the lamps, and have not burned incense or offered burnt offerings in the holy [place] to the God of Israel.

entries.title: II Chronicles 29:8
segments: "Therefore the wrath of the LORD fell upon Judah and Jerusalem, and He has given them up to trouble, to desolation, and to jeering, as you see with your eyes.

entries.title: II Chronicles 29:9
segments: "For indeed, because of this our fathers have fallen by the sword; and our sons, our daughters, and our wives [are] in captivity.

entries.title: II Chronicles 29:10
segments: "Now [it is] in my heart to make a covenant with the LORD God of Israel, that His fierce wrath may turn away from us.

entries.title: II Chronicles 29:11
segments: "My sons, do not be negligent now, for the LORD has chosen you to stand before Him, to serve Him, and that you should minister to Him and burn incense."

entries.title: II Chronicles 29:12
segments: ¶Then these Levites arose: Mahath the son of Amasai and Joel the son of Azariah, of the sons of the Kohathites; of the sons of Merari, Kish the son of Abdi and Azariah the son of Jehallelel; of the Gershonites, Joah the son of Zimmah and Eden the son of Joah;

entries.title: II Chronicles 29:13
segments: of the sons of Elizaphan, Shimri and Jeiel; of the sons of Asaph, Zechariah and Mattaniah;

entries.title: II Chronicles 29:14
segments: of the sons of Heman, Jehiel and Shimei; and of the sons of Jeduthun, Shemaiah and Uzziel.

entries.title: II Chronicles 29:15
segments: And they gathered their brethren, sanctified themselves, and went according to the commandment of the king, at the words of the LORD, to cleanse the house of the LORD.

entries.title: II Chronicles 29:16
segments: Then the priests went into the inner part of the house of the LORD to cleanse [it], and brought out all the debris that they found in the temple of the LORD to the court of the house of the LORD. And the Levites took [it] out and carried [it] to the Brook Kidron.

entries.title: II Chronicles 29:17
segments: Now they began to sanctify on the first [day] of the first month, and on the eighth day of the month they came to the vestibule of the LORD. Then they sanctified the house of the LORD in eight days, and on the sixteenth day of the first month they finished.

entries.title: II Chronicles 29:18
segments: Then they went in to King Hezekiah and said, "We have cleansed all the house of the LORD, the altar of burnt offerings with all its articles, and the table of the showbread with all its articles.

entries.title: II Chronicles 29:19
segments: "Moreover all the articles which King Ahaz in his reign had cast aside in his transgression we have prepared and sanctified; and there they [are], before the altar of the LORD."

entries.title: II Chronicles 29:20
segments: ¶Then King Hezekiah rose early, gathered the rulers of the city, and went up to the house of the LORD.

entries.title: II Chronicles 29:21
segments: And they brought seven bulls, seven rams, seven lambs, and seven male goats for a sin offering for the kingdom, for the sanctuary, and for Judah. Then he commanded the priests, the sons of Aaron, to offer [them] on the altar of the LORD.

entries.title: II Chronicles 29:22
segments: So they killed the bulls, and the priests received the blood and sprinkled [it] on the altar. Likewise they killed the rams and sprinkled the blood on the altar. They also killed the lambs and sprinkled the blood on the altar.

entries.title: II Chronicles 29:23
segments: Then they brought out the male goats [for] the sin offering before the king and the assembly, and they laid their hands on them.

entries.title: II Chronicles 29:24
segments: And the priests killed them; and they presented their blood on the altar as a sin offering to make an atonement for all Israel, for the king commanded [that] the burnt offering and the sin offering [be made] for all Israel.

entries.title: II Chronicles 29:25
segments: And he stationed the Levites in the house of the LORD with cymbals, with stringed instruments, and with harps, according to the commandment of David, of Gad the king's seer, and of Nathan the prophet; for thus [was] the commandment of the LORD by his prophets.

entries.title: II Chronicles 29:26
segments: The Levites stood with the instruments of David, and the priests with the trumpets.

entries.title: II Chronicles 29:27
segments: Then Hezekiah commanded [them] to offer the burnt offering on the altar. And when the burnt offering began, the song of the LORD [also] began, with the trumpets and with the instruments of David king of Israel.

entries.title: II Chronicles 29:28
segments: So all the assembly worshiped, the singers sang, and the trumpeters sounded; all [this continued] until the burnt offering was finished.

entries.title: II Chronicles 29:29
segments: And when they had finished offering, the king and all who were present with him bowed and worshiped.

entries.title: II Chronicles 29:30
segments: Moreover King Hezekiah and the leaders commanded the Levites to sing praise to the LORD with the words of David and of Asaph the seer. So they sang praises with gladness, and they bowed their heads and worshiped.

entries.title: II Chronicles 29:31
segments: Then Hezekiah answered and said, "Now [that] you have consecrated yourselves to the LORD, come near, and bring sacrifices and thank offerings into the house of the LORD." So the assembly brought in sacrifices and thank offerings, and as many as were of a willing heart [brought] burnt offerings.

entries.title: II Chronicles 29:32
segments: And the number of the burnt offerings which the assembly brought was seventy bulls, one hundred rams, [and] two hundred lambs; all these [were] for a burnt offering to the LORD.

entries.title: II Chronicles 29:33
segments: The consecrated things [were] six hundred bulls and three thousand sheep.

entries.title: II Chronicles 29:34
segments: But the priests were too few, so that they could not skin all the burnt offerings; therefore their brethren the Levites helped them until the work was ended and until the [other]  priests had sanctified themselves, for the Levites were more diligent in sanctifying themselves than the priests.

entries.title: II Chronicles 29:35
segments: Also the burnt offerings [were] in abundance, with the fat of the peace offerings and [with] the drink offerings for [every] burnt offering. So the service of the house of the LORD was set in order.

entries.title: II Chronicles 29:36
segments: Then Hezekiah and all the people rejoiced that God had prepared the people, since the events took place so suddenly.
